title: Price and test funded BIT observations for the helper-469 windows
body:
A same-grade replacement delivers the required observation to the second reader, then fails fourteen old outputs. The included two-world witness shows that even 22 granted chart-564 stock rows cannot recover protected output 150.

## Scope and source

Covers the specified chronological 469 split, the 2239 replacement and the corresponding dependent reads. The separately priced extra grade-one observation alone exhausts the positive hypothetical margin. The complete source comparator is #7830 at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`. The archive identifies additional inputs by exact commit, path and hash. Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; P104 toolkit #7852 `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`.

## Reproduction

Extract `research/p104-bit469-funded-observation/replay.tar.gz` into an empty directory. Check its inner checksum manifest. A cold single-CPU replay checked the original 680-owner forward and adjoint, the 681-owner diagnostic, paired invoice and negative controls. See the archive README for commands. The archive preserves the verification evidence and controls. This is an offline research archive; hosted package execution is separate.

## Open next questions

Find a different paid ancestor or a joint exterior repair that preserves all protected rows, then replay and price the entire supplier.

Clear1nsight prepared this result with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit DreamingOfClouds for the P104 toolkit and the predecessor authors identified in the archive.
